# dsh-model-group-collapse
English | 简体中文
A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI plugin that makes the **provider groups in the composer's model menu
ess (DSH) Web UI plugin that makes the **provider groups in the composer's model menu collapsible**.
## What it does
The stock model picker in the composer's tool row lists every provider group (DeepSeek Account, offi
cial endpoints, custom providers…) fully expanded. When you have many providers, the menu becomes a
long wall of models.
This plugin adds a collapsible layer to that menu:
- Every provider heading becomes a **toggle with a triangle caret** (`▸` collapsed / `▾` expanded).

- **All groups start collapsed** by default.
- The **provider of the currently selected model starts

expanded**.
- Click a heading to toggle that group; the caret flips and the group's models appear o

r disappear.
- While a **search query** is active, matched groups render expanded so results stay vi

sible; clearing the query restores the collapse state.
- Everything else keeps working unchanged: th
e two-level "Model / Effort" menu, search, keyboard navigation, the pending spinner, and the officia
l model-label badge (e.g. “1017”).
Disable the plugin in the plugin manager and the menu returns to its stock appearance immediately.

2. In DSH, open the plugin manager and install the bundle from

the local
directory, or use the CLI equivalent:
`dsh plugin install /path/to/dsh-model-group-collaps

e`
3. Reload the Web UI and open a conversation.

## Compatibility

- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.2` (client plugin API `dsh.client`).
- Works on top of the shipped mo

del picker: no component is replaced, so it
follows the host's own state (streaming lock, pending se

lection, search
filtering) instead of duplicating it.
## How it works

The shipped model menu renders its provider groups as
`section[data-menu-group]` elements, each with

a
`[data-menu-group-heading]` label and `button[role="menuitemradio"]` rows.
The client half watche

s the document for that menu while it is open and
decorates each group:

- the heading gets a triangle caret and becomes a `role="button"` toggle;
- a collapsed group hides

p and resets on every menu open, using the
current model's `aria-checked` row to pick the initially

every menu open, using the
current model's `aria-checked` row to pick the initially expanded group.

All styling is inline-scoped (`mgc-` prefix, `--dsw-alias-*` tokens), and every
DOM write is guarded

by an equality check so the menu's own MutationObserver
never re-enters.
